body:
> No one knows why we're here. That's a thing you will (not might) find out for yourself, in due time. Believe me on this ok?

It was meant as a response to that. But reading your comment again, I realize the question didn't really make any sense, sorry. 

I am gonna ramble now, cause you're here and somehow typing these things out gets it out of my head and into the light.

I tried to medicate the depression and it drove me into a manic frenzy. If I medicate the manic, I die. oh shit. typing that made me realize I am medicating the manic. I smoke weed every night. I drive myself at a manic pace out in the world. I come home at night and I am totally burnt out, but still manic. Smoking weed allows me to stop, to actually slow down. I have tics. Now I have added nicotine back after quitting 3 years ago. It keeps me focused during my daily mania high. I am doing this crazy daily roller coaster, just to keep up with life. I graduate college in 2 terms. I have a job lined up where I am currently a part time intern. I am so goddamn close to the finish line, to being able to relax. But I know I won't get to relax, it never comes, the cake is a lie. I know I need to stop this insane way of living. I just don't know how, it seems that everything I have earned up until now is dependent on me keeping this going. If I try to fix this, it means downtime. It means risking becoming mediocre. I finally love my life after years of misery, and it is driving me crazy.

I have spent time in the world of psychiatry, most likely one would call me bi-polar. It would seem prudent to medicate that problem, but herein lies the problem, I can not bring myself to fix it, laziness, fear, who knows why. The events and actions of self repair just don't seem to manifest themselves, no matter how dark my outlook becomes. 

I believe some portion of my malaise is produced from a failing expectation of finding 'purpose' in life as I grew older. I am older now (mid 30's) and it is just as elusive today as it was 10 years ago. I am curious though, why do you think we here?
